keyTakeaways: Keyboard or Plover text becomes source captions without opening a microphone.
Auto uses sentence boundaries and bounded waits; By line waits for a newline.
The source is human-written; automatic translations may be delayed or wrong.

faq.question: Do I need Plover to use text input?
faq.answer: No. An ordinary keyboard works too. Plover uses the same text field without a special plugin or dictionary upload. Configure one source language for the session.

faq.question: What is the difference between Auto and By line?
faq.answer: Auto uses sentence boundaries and bounded waits; By line waits for a newline.

faq.question: Can I correct text after sending it?
faq.answer: Edit the unsent draft freely. Submitted text may still await confirmation; only confirmed acceptance counts as publication. Later Backspace cannot rewrite accepted captions. Copy unsent text before leaving or refreshing.

faq.question: How can professional stenographers join the free trial?
faq.answer: Email [info@pockitle.com](mailto:info@pockitle.com) with your software, equipment and intended use. Trial arrangements and scope are agreed individually; no fixed duration, allowance or device certification is promised.

glossary.definition: Original-language text written by the operator, rather than generated by speech recognition in this mode.
Text not yet submitted, which the writer can revise or undo.
Text whose acceptance is confirmed for publication; later draft edits do not rewrite it.
